def status(schema):
    from .web_identity import pending_count
    with database() as conn:
        for table in ("source_record", "snapshot_page", "entry", "extraction", "extraction_failure", "profile", "embedding", "relation", "entry_signal", "entry_signal_analysis", "cluster", "cluster_member", "cluster_edge", "cluster_group", "cluster_group_member", "pair_feedback", "order_feedback", "inference_call"):
            print(f"{table}: {conn.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.{table}').fetchone()[0]}")
        multi, annotated = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE summary IS NOT NULL) FROM {schema}.cluster WHERE member_count>1").fetchone()
        print(f"multi-entry clusters: {multi}, annotated: {annotated}, pending: {multi - annotated}")
        subdivided = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.cluster_group WHERE source='strong_component'").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"subdivided parent groups: {subdivided}")
        for identity_status, count in conn.execute(f"SELECT status,count(*) FROM {schema}.web_identity GROUP BY status ORDER BY status"):
            print(f"web identity {identity_status}: {count}")
        print(f"web identity pending: {pending_count(schema)}")
        for kind, count in conn.execute(f"SELECT kind,count(*) FROM {schema}.extraction_failure GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind"):
            print(f"extraction failures for {kind}: {count}")
        partial = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.extraction WHERE partial").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"partial historical extractions: {partial}")
        missing_profiles = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.entry e LEFT JOIN {schema}.profile p ON p.entry_id=e.id WHERE p.entry_id IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"entries without profiles: {missing_profiles}")
        outdated = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.profile p JOIN {schema}.entry e ON e.id=p.entry_id WHERE e.updated_at>p.updated_at OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.extraction x WHERE x.entry_id=p.entry_id AND x.updated_at>p.updated_at)").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"profiles with newer evidence: {outdated}")
        old_version = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.profile WHERE prompt_version<>%s", (PROFILE_VERSION,)).fetchone()[0]
        print(f"profiles on older prompt: {old_version}")
        stale_embeddings = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.embedding v JOIN {schema}.profile p ON p.entry_id=v.entry_id WHERE p.updated_at>v.updated_at").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"embeddings behind profiles: {stale_embeddings}")
        stale_relations = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.relation r JOIN {schema}.profile a ON a.entry_id=r.left_id JOIN {schema}.profile b ON b.entry_id=r.right_id WHERE a.updated_at>r.updated_at OR b.updated_at>r.updated_at").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"relations behind profiles: {stale_relations}")
        for kind, count, rich in conn.execute(f"SELECT e.content_type,count(*),sum(CASE WHEN e.evidence_quality='rich' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.extraction x WHERE x.entry_id=e.id AND NOT x.partial AND length(x.text_content)>=400 AND (left(x.kind,4)<>'web:' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.web_identity w JOIN {schema}.source_record n ON n.resource='node' AND n.id=substring(x.kind from 5) WHERE w.entry_id=x.entry_id AND w.kind=x.kind AND w.status='accepted' AND w.saved_hash=n.sha256 AND w.extraction_updated_at=x.updated_at))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM {schema}.entry e GROUP BY e.content_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC"):
            print(f"{kind}: {count} entries, {rich} evidence-rich")


def neighbors(schema, anchor, limit):
    """Return model proximity with explicit pair and relative-order feedback applied."""
    with database() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT CASE WHEN r.left_id=%s THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END AS other, r.score, r.judgment->>'relation', e.label FROM {schema}.relation r JOIN {schema}.entry e ON e.id=CASE WHEN r.left_id=%s THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END WHERE r.left_id=%s OR r.right_id=%s", (anchor, anchor, anchor, anchor)).fetchall()
        ranked = {other: {"id": other, "score": score, "relation": relation, "label": label} for other, score, relation, label in rows}
        for left, right, score, label in conn.execute(f"SELECT left_id,right_id,score,label FROM {schema}.pair_feedback WHERE left_id=%s OR right_id=%s", (anchor, anchor)):
            other = right if left == anchor else left
            if other not in ranked:
                item = conn.execute(f"SELECT label FROM {schema}.entry WHERE id=%s", (other,)).fetchone()
                ranked[other] = {"id": other, "label": item[0] if item else None}
            ranked[other].update({"score": score, "relation": label, "feedback": True})
        ordered = sorted(ranked.values(), key=lambda item: (-item["score"], item["id"]))
        constraints = conn.execute(f"SELECT closer_id,farther_id FROM {schema}.order_feedback WHERE anchor_id=%s", (anchor,)).fetchall()
        output = apply_order_feedback(ordered, constraints)
        print(json.dumps(output[:limit], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def apply_order_feedback(ordered, constraints):
    """Respect acyclic closer-than constraints while retaining score order as tie-break."""
    positions = {item["id"]: index for index, item in enumerate(ordered)}
    ranked = {item["id"]: item for item in ordered}
    edges = defaultdict(set)
    indegree = {item["id"]: 0 for item in ordered}
    for closer, farther in constraints:
        if closer in positions and farther in positions and farther not in edges[closer]:
            edges[closer].add(farther)
            indegree[farther] += 1

def neighbors(schema, anchor, limit):
    """Return model proximity with explicit pair and relative-order feedback applied."""
    with database() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT CASE WHEN r.left_id=%s THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END AS other, r.score, r.judgment->>'relation', e.label FROM {schema}.relation r JOIN {schema}.entry e ON e.id=CASE WHEN r.left_id=%s THEN r.right_id ELSE r.left_id END WHERE r.left_id=%s OR r.right_id=%s", (anchor, anchor, anchor, anchor)).fetchall()

    """Respect acyclic closer-than constraints while retaining score order as tie-break."""
    positions = {item["id"]: index for index, item in enumerate(ordered)}
    ranked = {item["id"]: item for item in ordered}
    edges = defaultdict(set)
    indegree = {item["id"]: 0 for item in ordered}
    for closer, farther in constraints:
        if closer in positions and farther in positions and farther not in edges[closer]:

"""Wake the hourly recovery agent only when the backfill needs inspection."""

import os
import subprocess
import sys

from mgraph.cli import config, database


def main():
    """Return zero for investigation and one when the backfill is healthy."""
    os.environ.setdefault("PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT", "10")
    try:
        schema = config()
        with database() as conn:
            profile_count = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.profile").fetchone()[0]
            embedding_count = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.embedding").fetchone()[0]
            relation_count = conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.relation").fetchone()[0]
            recent_calls = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT count(*) FROM {schema}.inference_call "
                "WHERE created_at > now() - interval '60 minutes'"
            ).fetchone()[0]
        processes = subprocess.check_output(
            ["ps", "-axo", "command="], text=True, timeout=10
        ).splitlines()
        runners = sum(
